title: LLM-assisted schematic test-report analysis and root-cause investigation - Semiwiki
gist: Piyush Bag describes using an LLM to group, explain and suggest root-cause fixes for schematic topology-test failures in data-center switch PCB design, validated against a golden dataset, and predicts CAD tools exposing official MCPs will let hardware engineers 'vibe design and test'.

insights.claim: In network-switch PCB design, organizations without git-style practices manually run topology tests, aggregate CLI logs and triage errors one at a time in a shared document, which slows development as designs scale.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Hardware design workflows still carry large manual overhead that AI tooling can address.
insights.locator: Broadly, when a data center network switch

insights.claim: Catching schematic errors before manufacturing saves significant money, but the manual triage process slows the development lifecycle.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Explains the ROI case for automating pre-production validation.
insights.quote: it saves a lot of money in the early phase before manufacturing, since errors are caught before production, but it also slows the development lifecycle
insights.locator: Broadly, when a data center network switch

insights.claim: The LLM-based schematic report generator ingests schematic revisions, topology test results, job info, raw logs, nets, pins and component references, normalized into Markdown context with examples and exceptions.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Shows a practical retrofit pattern for AI in legacy hardware orgs.

insights.claim: The system creates separate context per failure group (e.g. missing connection on a net) and has the LLM explain results and recommend root-cause fixes, with outputs checked against a golden dataset of previously reviewed cases in JSON.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Eval-driven LLM deployment is the template for trustworthy EDA-adjacent AI.
insights.quote: To ensure the LLM output is correct, it is compared with a golden dataset of previously reviewed schematic test cases in JSON format.

insights.claim: The author argues organizations need not become AI-native from day one; integrating AI automation into existing waterfall/iterative hardware processes can speed development.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Incremental AI adoption lowers the barrier for incumbent hardware teams.
insights.locator: One managerial solution is to pivot

insights.claim: The hardware design engineer still makes the final decision on schematic design and electrical root cause after reviewing the LLM report.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Human-in-the-loop remains required, limiting full automation near term.

insights.claim: The author predicts that if traditional CAD tools provide official MCPs to act on topology test results, the process becomes agentic and hardware engineers will 'vibe design and test' like software engineers.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: CAD/EDA vendors that expose agent interfaces (MCP) could become hubs of agentic hardware workflows.
insights.quote: just as software engineers are “vibing,” hardware design engineers will soon “vibe design and test” too
